hooks.text: 全队投票决定下一轮敌人变异
hooks.excerpt: Between each mission, players must vote between a random selection of mutations that will grant enemies new traits and abilities. Fortunately, this choice will also offer the players immediate or long-term benefits, making the decision less obvious but more critical.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 在贪婪与撤退间赌每份奖励
hooks.excerpt: Every second counts, and every reward is associated with a risk. Success must be found in the delicate sweet spot between boldness and greed.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 职业增益与枪械模组联动构筑
hooks.excerpt: Choose a loadout that fits your style and then mod it with upgrades to your personal preference. A clever combination of perks and gun mods will turn you into an unstoppable mutant killing machine in no time.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 后期画面信息过度拥挤。

excerpts.excerpt: Visual clutter gets insane later on
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 玩法容易变得无聊且重复。

excerpts.excerpt: It's just so wildly boring and repetitive
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 长期游玩缺少有效局外成长。

excerpts.excerpt: the upgrades for your character are a little underwhelming
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 部分周目过度依赖随机性。

excerpts.excerpt: Some runs depend heavily on RNG
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 武器和升级平衡不完善。
屏幕过于拥挤时性能会下降。

excerpts.excerpt: Performance can dip when the screen gets too crowded
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 内容解锁过程可能显得重复刷取。

excerpts.excerpt: Can feel grindy when unlocking content
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 角色等级成长过程过于肝。
不同角色、武器和解锁形成可持续的体验循环。

excerpts.excerpt: 解锁新角色-通关-解锁新武器-新武器还会给之前通关过的角色新体验，这样一个良性循环可以持续很久
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
